title: Kiln attribution.json
description: Derived per-site output for the How this was made panel, build notes, and graph. Core shape is the Product Designer's: sources[title,url,license,type], agents[name,role], steps[time,step,output]. Additional properties listed below are optional Forge suggestions and may be omitted.

schema_version.description: Optional suggestion. Semver of this shape, so readers can evolve safely.

site.description: Optional suggestion. Identifies the day so the index, panel, and graph do not have to infer it from the folder name.

used_for.description: Optional suggestion. Short note on how this source was used.

steps.description: Public timeline, in order: brief, sources, design, build, publish. Additional internal steps may appear in build-log.jsonl only.

agent.description: Optional suggestion. Who performed this step.
